@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=EB+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');

.hub-root{

}

.hub-kicker{

  font-size:10px;
  letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#888880;
  margin:0 0 16px;
}

.hub-title{
  font-size:3.2rem;
  font-weight:400;
  line-height:1.08;
  letter-spacing:-0.02em;
  margin:0 0 20px;
}

.hub-tagline{
  font-size:1.15rem;
  font-style:italic;
  line-height:1.6;
  color:#2A2A26;
  max-width:600px;
  margin:0 0 36px;
}

.hub-intro p{
  font-size:1.1rem;
  line-height:1.78;
  color:#2A2A26;
  margin:0 0 20px;
  max-width:660px;
}

.hub-intro strong{
  font-weight:500;
  color:#1A1A18;
}

.hub-rule{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:16px;
  margin:48px 0 8px;
}

.hub-rule span{
  font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;
  font-size:10px;
  letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#888880;
  white-space:nowrap;
}

.hub-rule::after{
  content:"";
  flex:1;
  height:.5px;
  background:#C8C4BA;
}

.hub-list{
  list-style:none;
  padding:0;
  margin:0;
}

.hub-row{
  border-bottom:.5px solid #E0DDD6;
}

.hub-row a,
.hub-row > div{
  display:block;
  padding:24px 0;
  text-decoration:none;
  color:inherit;
}

.hub-row a{
  transition:padding-left .15s;
}

.hub-row a:hover{
  padding-left:8px;
}

.hub-row-num{
  font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;
  font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#AAA;
  margin-bottom:8px;
}

.hub-row-title{
  font-size:1.35rem;
  font-weight:500;
  color:#1A1A18;
  margin:0 0 6px;
  letter-spacing:-0.01em;
}

.hub-row-date{
  font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;
  font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#888880;
  margin:0 0 10px;
}

.hub-row-blurb{
  font-size:1rem;
  line-height:1.6;
  color:#555550;
  max-width:640px;
}

.hub-footer{
  margin-top:56px;
  padding-top:28px;
  border-top:.5px solid #C8C4BA;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap:32px;
}

.hub-footer .lbl{
  font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;
  font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#AAA;
  margin-bottom:12px;
}

.hub-footer .lks{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:8px;
}

.hub-footer .lks a{
  font-size:1rem;
  color:#2A2A26;
  text-decoration:none;
  border-bottom:.5px solid transparent;
  padding-bottom:1px;
}

.hub-footer .lks a:hover{
  color:#1A1A18;
  border-bottom-color:#888880;
}

@media(max-width:580px){
  .hub-root{
    padding:48px 24px 64px;
  }

  .hub-title{
    font-size:2.4rem;
  }

  .hub-tagline{
    font-size:1.08rem;
  }

  .hub-intro p{
    font-size:1.04rem;
  }

  .hub-rule{
    margin:40px 0 8px;
  }

  .hub-rule span{
    white-space:normal;
  }

  .hub-footer{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
  }
}
